name: Armor Piercing (AP)
description: Ignores a number of armor points equal to its AP value (e.g., AP 2 ignores 2 points of armor).

name: Heavy Weapon
description: Can damage vehicles or targets with Heavy Armor. Typically requires Strength d8 or higher.

name: Two-Handed
description: Requires both hands to wield, often increasing damage (e.g., +d8 for greatswords).

name: Reach
description: Extends melee range by +1 inch or more, allowing attacks from further away.

name: Parry Penalty
description: Reduces the wielder's Parry score by 1 or more when equipped.

name: Minimum Strength
description: Requires a minimum Strength die (e.g., d8) to use without penalties to attack or Pace.

name: Rate of Fire (RoF)
description: Allows multiple attack rolls per round (e.g., RoF 3 for three attacks).

name: Reload
description: Requires one or more actions to reload before firing again.

name: Snapfire
description: Imposes a -2 penalty to attack rolls if the wielder moves in the same turn.

name: Double Tap
description: Fires two rounds, granting +1 to hit and +1 to damage.

name: Three-Round Burst
description: Fires three rounds, granting +2 to hit and +1 to damage.

name: Fragile
description: Breaks on a critical failure or under specific conditions, rendering it unusable.

name: Cumbersome
description: Imposes a -1 penalty to Agility-based rolls when equipped.

name: Noisy
description: Makes stealth difficult, imposing a -2 penalty to Stealth rolls or alerting enemies.

name: Concealable
description: Grants a +2 bonus to checks to hide the item on the user's person.

name: Silvered
description: Effective against supernatural creatures like werewolves, bypassing their resistances.

name: Blessed
description: Deals +2 damage to unholy creatures (e.g., demons, undead).

name: Cold Iron
description: Effective against fae or magical creatures, ignoring their magical resistances.

name: Armor Bonus
description: Increases wearer's Toughness by a specified amount (e.g., +2).

name: Partial Protection
description: Covers specific body areas (e.g., torso), leaving others vulnerable.

name: Full Protection
description: Covers all body areas, maximizing Toughness bonus.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Protects against Heavy Weapons, requiring Heavy Weapon to damage.

name: Encumbering
description: Reduces Pace by 1 or increases Fatigue when worn for extended periods.

name: Quick Draw
description: Reduces time to ready the weapon, ignoring multi-action penalties for drawing.

name: Improvised
description: Suffers -2 to attack rolls unless the user has the Improvised Weapon Edge.

name: Nonlethal
description: Deals Fatigue instead of Wounds, used for incapacitating without killing.

name: Poisoned
description: Forces a Vigor roll on hit or inflicts Fatigue or other poison effects.

name: Entangling
description: Traps or slows the target, requiring a Strength or Agility roll to escape.

name: Defensive
description: Grants +1 to Parry when equipped, enhancing defensive capability.

name: Glowing
description: Emits light in a Small Burst Template, negating illumination penalties.

name: Power Point Drain
description: Drains 1d4 Power Points from the target on a successful hit.

name: Spell Focus
description: Grants +1 to Spellcasting rolls when used as a focus for arcane powers.

name: Unstable
description: May malfunction or explode on a critical failure, causing damage to the user.

name: Shock
description: Forces a Vigor roll or the target becomes Shaken on a successful hit.

name: Fire-Based
description: Ignites flammable targets on a damage roll of 6, causing ongoing damage.

name: Cold-Based
description: Slows target or inflicts Fatigue on hit, requiring a Vigor roll.
